proposals.label: Beryllium-10 and nitrate concentration spikes in ice cores (radiation-exposure proxy)
proposals.rationale: brakenridge-2011-supernova-c0 cites ice-core 10Be and nitrate spikes as the physical evidence for a supernova trigger, a distinct chemical marker not covered by the existing platinum/iridium/nanodiamond/spherule/meltglass object entries.

proposals.label: Absence of a confirmed impact crater matching the proposed 12.9 ka event
proposals.rationale: boslough-2012-chapter-c0 explicitly weighs the impact hypothesis against the lack of any known crater, a distinct line of physical evidence not represented among the current object entries (which cover ejecta markers but not crater evidence itself).

proposals.label: Abrupt Northern Hemisphere warming events (independent of Younger Dryas cooling) as megafaunal extinction driver
proposals.rationale: cooper-2015-c0 argues ancient-DNA megafaunal population turnover tracks rapid post-glacial warming pulses rather than the 12.9 ka Younger Dryas cooling onset, naming a causal driver distinct from all triggers currently listed for the cooling event.
